thread:
Priya: Quick idea for safer runtime config rollouts: introduce a short activation token (human-copyable) attached to a snapshot. Use it for quick-promote and strict activation semantics so we never have half-applied configs when services lag.
Jon H: Sounds promising. How is this different from snapshot ids or tagging snapshots with release names?
Priya: snapshot ids are long and not operator-friendly. Tokens let an operator paste a 6-char code in the console and trigger the exact snapshot. Also useful for chat ops: paste token in an incident and promote.
Evelyn: From router POV, this adds a second lookup path. We need a deterministic map token->snapshot-hash. Concern: cache growth and TTL.
Kai: Agree. Suggest tokens be ephemeral (default 7d) and auto-prune. Pinning requires two approvals and writes an audit event.
Priya: UX: preview API should accept token and simulate rollout windows + show telemetry diffs vs baseline. We already have /preview, extend it for token param and lookback minutes.
Jon H: Telemetry gating is important. Require N samples and a small regression-check before allowing full promotion. Make it opt-out per team.
Evelyn: Quotas: we should not duplicate quota buckets by token. Keep quota keyed to route-model, but add token tag for attribution during rollout so billing/limits show the split.
Kai: Migration plan? Start preview-only; then dry-run router that logs token resolution but doesn't split traffic; finally enable canary splits by token.
deploy-bot: preview-api v2 rolled to staging at 2024-11-04T09:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
Priya: Also enforce immutability invariant: token must map to a snapshot hash; attempting to change snapshot content under same token returns 409 unless force=true with audit reason.
Jon H: API sketch:
POST /snapshots/{id}/activate
{ "token": "t-1b2c3d", "mode": "canary", "pct": 3, "pin": false }
-> returns rollout_id or 409 on conflict.
Evelyn: Fallback behavior: if token lookup fails at runtime, route to default snapshot and emit token.resolve.miss metric. That keeps production safe.
Kai: Telemetry storage cost: retain per-token metrics short-term (7d), then roll into aggregated snapshot baseline. Console should surface active tokens and short-term deltas (latency, error-rate, cost).
Priya: Ops runbook: 1) quick-promote previous token 2) if rollback fails, hit model fallback 3) page on-call. Console quick-promote should require dry-run + 2 approvers for pinned tokens.
Jon H: Lint: warn if pinned token has no telemetry for >2 hours. Prevent promoting blind.
Priya: I'll write an RFC with mocks, propose token-format base36 6 chars. Plan: preview-only in 2w, dry-run router 5w, full rollout 9w. Assign reviewers.
Evelyn: Add perf guard: abort full rollout if token.resolve.miss rate > 0.1% across region.
Kai: I'll draft the telemetry gate thresholds and minimal eval prompt set.
Priya: Thanks — tagging @deploy-bot to open RFC issue and link mocks.
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://go/infra/issue/4620 (Priya assigned) :spiral_note_pad:
Jon H: One naming nit: maybe call it activation-token in APIs rather than token so it's searchable.
Priya: good point, will pick explicit name in RFC. Scheduling 30m sync next week.
